newsitem.title: USA: PACE hires Cowen to explore alternatives.
newsitem.headline: PACE hires Cowen to explore alternatives.

text.p: PACE Health Management Systems Inc said it engaged Cowen & Co as its lead investment banker to help the company explore "various alternatives, including debt or equity offerings as well as strategic alliance opportunities."

"We believe that additional capital resources will not only provide funding for growth and development, but will also result in a stronger balance sheet that will reflect the stability prospective customers will be evaluating as the size of our installations increase," said Roger Huseman, chief financial officer of the healthcare data software firm.
